title: A Day at the Market (יום בשוק)
text: On Fridays my mother and I go to the market. We buy fresh vegetables, fruit and bread. The market is busy and noisy, but the food is cheaper than in the shop. We always stop for a coffee before we go home.

questions.question: When do they go to the market?
Why do they like the market?

title: Learning to Swim (ללמוד לשחות)
text: When I was young, I was afraid of water. Last summer I decided to take swimming lessons. At first it was hard and I felt nervous, but my teacher was patient. Now I can swim well and I love going to the pool.

questions.question: What was the writer afraid of?
How was the teacher?

title: A New Phone (טלפון חדש)
text: Last week I bought a new phone. My old phone was slow and the battery was bad. The new one is faster and takes great photos. It was expensive, but I think it was a good choice.

questions.question: Why did the writer buy a new phone?
What does the new phone do well?

title: Weekend Plans (תוכניות לסוף השבוע)
text: This weekend my friends and I are going to the beach. We will bring food and play music. If the weather is good, we will stay until the evening. I really hope it does not rain.

questions.question: Where are they going?
What might stop their plans?

title: My Grandmother's Recipe (המתכון של סבתא)
text: My grandmother makes the best soup. She learned the recipe from her mother. Every winter she invites the whole family for dinner. She says the secret is to cook it slowly and add a lot of love.

questions.question: Who did the grandmother learn the recipe from?
What is the 'secret' of the soup?

title: The Job Interview (ראיון העבודה)
text: Last week I had my first job interview. I was nervous, so I arrived early and wore my best clothes. The manager asked me about my experience. I tried to stay calm and answer clearly. Two days later, they offered me the job!

questions.question: How did the writer feel before the interview?
What happened two days later?

title: Cooking Together (מבשלים ביחד)
text: My friends and I meet every month to cook a meal together. Each person brings one ingredient. We do not always know what we will make! Last time we made a big vegetable soup, and it was delicious.

questions.question: How often do they meet?
What did they make last time?

title: Lost in the City (אבודים בעיר)
text: When we visited a new city, we got lost. The map on my phone stopped working. We asked a friendly woman for directions. She walked with us part of the way. Thanks to her, we found our hotel.

questions.question: Why did they get lost?
questions.explanation: 'The map on my phone stopped working'.

title: A New Language (שפה חדשה)
text: Last year I started to learn Spanish. At first it was hard to remember the words. Now I practise a little every day with an app. I can already understand simple sentences, and that makes me proud.

questions.question: What language is the writer learning?
How does the writer practise now?

title: The Broken Phone (הטלפון השבור)
text: Yesterday I dropped my phone and the screen broke. I took it to a shop near my office. The man said he could fix it in one hour. It was not cheap, but now it works again.

questions.question: What happened to the phone?
How long did the repair take?

title: Saving for a Trip (חיסכון לטיול)
text: My sister and I want to travel to Italy next summer. Every month we save a little money. We don't buy things we don't need. It is not easy, but the idea of seeing Rome keeps us going.

questions.question: Where do they want to travel?
How do they save money?
options: They don't buy things they don't need

title: A Change of Plans (שינוי בתוכניות)
text: We wanted to go camping, but the weather forecast said heavy rain. So we changed our plans and visited a museum instead. It turned out to be a great day, and we learned a lot about history.

questions.question: Why did they change plans?
Where did they go instead?

title: My First Job (העבודה הראשונה שלי)
text: My first job was in a small café. I had to wake up early and I was often tired. But I learned how to talk to customers and work in a team. The money was not great, but the experience was worth it.

questions.question: Where was the first job?
What did the writer learn?
options: To talk to customers and work in a team
questions.explanation: 'talk to customers and work in a team'.
